paragraphs.text: Duler Sanctum is the home of the Duler Angels of Lat-Nam , part of the Terisian Isles of Dominaria .
Although the Duler Angels have human rather than celestial origins, they keep their sanctum pristine, with balconies and fountains for miles.

When Greensleeves and her retinue arrived on Lat-Nam , they were soon attacked by the Duler Angels. They were beaten back though, and a few of the angels were killed. One was captured, but killed himself on Kuni 's sword. The angels were later sought out by Greensleeves, who showed them the Stone Brain and managed to parley with them, earning their respect and ceasing the hostilities.
